about: How a protagonist comes into a settlement, by the country it stands in; and what each trade looks like from the road.

marsh.name: the causeway into {home}
marsh.scene: The causeway runs on its piles across the last of the fen, and at the end of it is {home}: low roofs against the sky, {trade}, boats drawn up on the landing, smoke going straight up from the inn.

forest.name: the road into {home}
forest.scene: The road comes out from under the trees, and there is {home} in its clearing: the green, the inn, the shrine, {trade}, smoke from a dozen chimneys.

mountain.name: the road down into {home}
mountain.scene: The road comes down off the high ground in long zigzags, and {home} is below you at the foot of it: stone roofs, a green, {trade}, the inn chimney smoking.

frost.name: the road into {home}
frost.scene: The road comes in between the snow-fences, and {home} is ahead of you: low roofs weighted with turf, {trade}, smoke from the inn, a dog barking at nothing.

trade.charcoal: the blue smoke of the charcoal hearths
trade.timber: timber stacked to season along the road
trade.honey: bee-skeps in rows along the garden walls
trade.tin: spoil heaps grey above the roofs
trade.furs: pelts stretched on frames by the doors
